title: Blessings for Obedience

questions.question: What are the two specific commands given at the beginning of this chapter?
options: Do not make idols and keep My Sabbaths
Love your neighbor and honor your parents
Do not steal and do not kill
questions.correctAnswer: Do not make idols and keep My Sabbaths
questions.explanation: Leviticus 26:1-2 (ESV): "You shall not make idols... You shall keep my Sabbaths and reverence my sanctuary."

questions.question: If Israel walks in God's statutes, what will the land yield?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 26:4 (ESV): "The land shall yield its increase, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit."

questions.question: What blessing of peace is promised?
options: You shall lie down, and none shall make you afraid
questions.correctAnswer: You shall lie down, and none shall make you afraid
questions.explanation: Leviticus 26:6 (ESV): "I will give peace in the land, and you shall lie down, and none shall make you afraid."

questions.question: How many of you shall chase ten thousand?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 26:8 (ESV): "Five of you shall chase a hundred, and a hundred of you shall chase ten thousand."

questions.question: What will happen if they do not listen and do not do all these commandments?
options: God will appoint over them sudden terror
questions.correctAnswer: God will appoint over them sudden terror
questions.explanation: Leviticus 26:16 (ESV): "I will do this to you: I will visit you with panic (sudden terror)..."

questions.question: If they still do not listen after punishment, how many times more will God punish them?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 26:18 (ESV): "I will discipline you again sevenfold for your sins."

questions.question: What will happen to your strength if you disobey?
options: It shall be spent in vain
questions.correctAnswer: It shall be spent in vain
questions.explanation: Leviticus 26:20 (ESV): "Your strength shall be spent in vain, for your land shall not yield its increase."

questions.question: What will God send among them to destroy their cattle and reduce their number?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 26:22 (ESV): "I will let loose the wild beasts against you, which shall bereave you of your children and destroy your livestock."

questions.question: What will happen to the land while they are in exile?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 26:34 (ESV): "Then the land shall enjoy its Sabbaths as long as it lies desolate... then the land shall rest."

questions.question: If they confess their iniquity, what will God remember?
options: His covenant with Jacob, Isaac, and Abraham
questions.correctAnswer: His covenant with Jacob, Isaac, and Abraham
questions.explanation: Leviticus 26:42 (ESV): "Then I will remember my covenant with Jacob... Isaac... Abraham."

questions.question: What is the "faintness" described for those left in the land of their enemies?
options: The sound of a driven leaf shall put them to flight
questions.correctAnswer: The sound of a driven leaf shall put them to flight
questions.explanation: Leviticus 26:36 (ESV): "The sound of a driven leaf shall put them to flight... and they shall fall when none pursues."

questions.question: In the siege, what desperate act are they predicted to do?
options: Eat the flesh of their sons and daughters
questions.correctAnswer: Eat the flesh of their sons and daughters
questions.explanation: Leviticus 26:29 (ESV): "You shall eat the flesh of your sons, and you shall eat the flesh of your daughters."

questions.question: What will God do to their sanctuaries?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 26:31 (ESV): "I will make your sanctuaries desolate, and I will not smell your pleasing aromas."

questions.question: Despite all this, when they are in the land of their enemies, what will God NOT do?
options: Spurn them not, neither abhor them so as to destroy them utterly
questions.correctAnswer: Spurn them not, neither abhor them so as to destroy them utterly
questions.explanation: Leviticus 26:44 (ESV): "I will not spurn them, neither will I abhor them so as to destroy them utterly and break my covenant."

questions.question: Where were these statutes and laws made?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 26:46 (ESV): "These are the statutes... which the Lord made between himself and the people of Israel on Mount Sinai by the hand of Moses."

key_verse_text: And I will walk among you and will be your God, and you shall be my people.
